newsitem.title: UK: GRE says to shed 350 jobs in restructuring.
newsitem.headline: GRE says to shed 350 jobs in restructuring.

text.p: British insurance group Guardian Royal Exchange said on Tuesday it was to shed 350 jobs in the restructuring of its area and branch network following the acquisition of Legal & General's commercial insurance operation in July this year.
The company said it would close one office in each of seven towns where there is currently both a Guardian Insurance and former Legal & General office, and offices in five other locations.
GRE says to shed 350 jobs in restructuring
The operations of the London & Anglia area are to be integrated into the South East and Midlands areas respectively.
The restructuring is expected to be completed by summer 1997.
Guardian said the restructuring is intended to enhance the level of service to intermediaries and to benefit from the opportunities for economies of scale flowing from the acquisition.
Guardian bought the Legal & General unit for 48 million pounds ($78.85 million). ($1=.6087 Pound)
